title: QUIC RFC 9000 0-RTT Remembered Transport Parameter Policy Verification
verification_method: Focused S7P4P1 requirement-home tests over transport-parameter 0-RTT storage classification, prohibited-value exclusion, and detached-ticket remembered-subset readiness, plus Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, full Release test suite, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers the client-side remembered transport-parameter subset used to determine whether a detached resumption ticket carries usable 0-RTT transport-parameter prerequisites.
expected_result: The focused tests show every known modeled transport parameter has an explicit 0-RTT storage classification, prohibited parameters are excluded from the client remembered 0-RTT subset, processable parameters are retained, and a ticket carrying only prohibited transport parameters does not enable dormant 0-RTT readiness.
procedure: Run the focused S7P4P1 and CRT resumption/0-RTT guard filter.
Run the full Release test suite without rebuilding.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: Detached resumption tickets can carry a raw peer transport-parameter snapshot.
Dormant early-data readiness remains an internal observation and public early-data admission remains closed.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim S7P4P1 server acceptance or rejection policy, restored transport-parameter support checks, updated transport-parameter violation handling, TLS early_data extension support, public early-data APIs, anti-replay behavior, or application-data delivery.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-06. The Release build passed with 0 warnings and 0 errors, the focused S7P4P1 plus CRT resumption/0-RTT guard filter passed 16/16, regenerated coverage triage marks REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S7P4P1-0001, REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S7P4P1-0002, and RFC9000-S7-4-1-P5-R01 trace_clean and reports 1,264 of 1,771 QUIC requirements trace-clean overall, core SpecTrace JSON validation passed for 448 artifacts, the full Release no-build suite passed 4,469/4,469, and git diff --check returned exit code 0 with line-ending warnings only.
